1.w: Of David. YHWH [is] my light and my salvation—of whom shall I be afraid? YHWH [is] the strength of my life—of whom shall I be in dread?

2.w: In the coming near [of] the wicked against me, for the eating of my flesh, my adversaries and my enemies to me, they stumble and fall.

3.w: Though a host may encamp against me, my heart will not fear; though war should rise up against me, in this I will keep my trust.

4.w: One [thing] I have asked from YHWH—it do I seek—that I may dwell in the house of YHWH all the days of my life, to look on the beauty of YHWH, and to inquire in His temple.

5.w: For He will hide me in His shelter in the day of evil; He will conceal me under the cover of His tent; upon a rock He will set me high.

6.w: And now my head will be held high over my enemies all around me, and I will offer in His tent sacrifices of shouting; I will sing and make music to YHWH.

7.w: Hear, O YHWH, my voice [when] I call, and be merciful to me and answer me.

8.w: You have said [to] my heart “Seek My face.” Your face, O YHWH, I will seek.

9.w: Do not hide Your face from me; do not stretch Your servant away in anger! You have been my help—do not leave me and do not forsake me, O God of my salvation.

10.w: Though my father and my mother have forsaken me, yet YHWH will gather me [in].

11.w: Teach me Your way, O YHWH, and lead me on a level path, on account of my enemies.

12.w: Do not give me up to the desires of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen against me, and they breathe out violence.

13.w: Still I believed to look on the goodness of YHWH in the land of the living.

14.w: Wait for YHWH; be strong and let your heart be courageous. And wait for YHWH!
